answer_1.quote: We choose the TRUE benchmark -A collection consolidating 11 existing datasets annotated for factual consistency in a unified format -as a case-study and empirically investigate its labeling quality. Specifically, we analyze four datasets from TRUE with binary factual consistency annotation originating from different tasks.
answer_1.outputs: factual consistency labels, summary quality scores

answer_2.quote: We report average results of five seeds... Model Rank ROC AUC F1 Score Accuracy

answer_3.quote: we consider the LLM-as-a-judge approach, and propose a simple yet effective method... Re-label examples from existing datasets using an ensemble of LLMs.

answer_4.quote: The evaluation set was further reannotated by two experts and three crowd workers... Each example was independently annotated by both experts on a scale from 0 (inconsistent) to 1 (consistent).
answer_4.guideline: Please assess the factual consistency of <HYPOTHESIS> with respect to <PREMISE>. If the content of <HYPOTHESIS> aligns with the information provided in <PREMISE>, assign a label of 1. If there are factual inconsistencies between <HYPOTHESIS> and <PREMISE>, assign a label of 0.
